snippet.title: Bachelairs -  Race through a set of short dungeons, trying to collect the most treasures!
snippet.description:
Purchase on itch.io https://sokpop.itch.io/bachelairs?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt Bachelairs is foremost a local multiplayer game where you race through a short set of dungeons. The goal is to collect the most coins, which can be done via collecting treasures, beating up monsters, investing in better gear or winning awards.

A kingdom far away is in need of brave warriors to help them get rid of a dungeon problem. Therefore they organized a grand tournament! Bachelors from across the kingdom will enter the dungeons, fight the monsters and loot the treasures there. The one that collects the most coin will win the cup and gets to marry one of the princes or princesses!

➡️ More from Sokpop Collective https://sokpop.itch.io/?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt
➡️ More dungeon crawlers https://itch.io/games/tag-dungeon-crawler?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt
